focus: Explain discrete entropy: show each probability contribution, handle p=0, and demonstrate certainty versus four equally likely outcomes.
audience: Second-year engineering undergraduate familiar with logarithms
title: Synthetic Entropy Teaching Note
excerpt: Section 6: Entropy. For probabilities p_i summing to one, entropy is H = -sum_i p_i log2(p_i) bits. The contribution of a zero-probability outcome is defined as zero. A certain outcome has zero entropy. Four equally likely outcomes have entropy two bits. This synthetic passage is an integration fixture, not a research paper.
